review_version.description: Tag of the last manual or policy review that touched this entry.

category_path.description: Manual category path for the function. Null only if unknown.

url.description: Manual page URL for the function. Anchor form is preferred when available.

peer_reviewed.description: True when a second reviewer confirmed the flags; false for self-reviewed; null when not reviewed.

is_deprecated.description: Function is marked as deprecated in the spec/manual.

is_safe.description: Function is acceptable for arbitrary mod use.

is_sandboxed.description: Function cannot access non-exposed project data and cannot read or affect global engine state outside exposed handles.

is_file_io.description: Reads/writes files, folders, or paths, or launches OS file pickers.

is_network_io.description: Performs HTTP, sockets, matchmaking, platform network APIs, analytics, cloud, or any network traffic.

is_personal_data.description: Accesses or can reliably infer user/system information.

is_platform_specific.description: Function is tied to a platform or service.

is_global_reflection.description: Reads or mutates engine-wide or game-wide global state.

is_asset_reflection.description: Creates, enumerates, resolves, or reveals project-level assets beyond explicitly exposed handles.

is_os_reflection.description: Reads from, reveals, or mutates OS, device, window, browser, native extension, or host environment state.

is_lifecycle_state.description: Participates in an ordered active workflow where calls must be paired or sequenced, such as begin/end, open/close, or create/save-finalize.

is_compile_time_possible.description: True when the function can be reduced to a pure return at compile time, but only if every argument is expressible as a compile-time literal.

notes.description: Reviewer notes for non-obvious flags, platform quirks, policy assumptions, or follow-up context. This field is validated in source records but omitted from resolved exports.

is_return_pure.description: Function primarily exists to produce a return value; unused returns may be warned, errored, or removed when valid.

is_async_reflection.description: Starts, participates in, or reflects an asynchronous workflow or async event result.

is_callback_invoker.description: Invokes, schedules, stores, or later calls a supplied function/script/method callback.
